title: Replit 将 OpenAI 设为默认模型供应商，取代 Anthropic
desc: CEO Masad 澄清 OpenAI 取代 Anthropic 成为平台默认模型，Claude 仍对客户开放。
title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default model provider, replacing Anthropic
desc_en: CEO Masad clarified that OpenAI replaces Anthropic as the platform's default model, while Claude remains available to customers.

title: Meta 联手苹果推出全美最强开源模型，编码基测输给智谱、Kimi
desc: 新开源模型在通用能力上领先，但编码基准落后于中国模型。
title_en: Meta teams up with Apple to launch the strongest open-source model in the US, but loses to Zhipu and Kimi on coding benchmarks
desc_en: The new open-source model leads on general capabilities but trails Chinese models on coding benchmarks.

title: Meta 删除引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款表述
desc: Meta 更新服务条款，移除相关措辞，但发言人称爬虫方式未变。
title_en: Meta removes terms language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
desc_en: Meta updated its terms of service to remove the wording, but a spokesperson said scraping practices are unchanged.

title: Anthropic 提议的 AI 安全法案仅在 50 人死亡或 10 亿美元损失时才触发
desc: 该提案实质上让商务部成为唯一能叫停 AI 模型的机构。
title_en: Anthropic's proposed AI safety bill only triggers at 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages
desc_en: The proposal effectively makes the Commerce Department the only agency able to halt an AI model.

title: Anthropic 初级岗位占比从 27% 降至 9%，AI Agent 工时是人类 6 倍
desc: 公司内部 Agent 记录工时已达人类 6 倍，研究者警告“认知公地悲剧”。
title_en: Anthropic's junior roles drop from 27% to 9%, AI agents log 6x human work hours
desc_en: Internal agent-recorded work hours have reached 6x human hours, and researchers warn of a "cognitive commons tragedy."

title: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon Agent 无人类协助通关 Minecraft
desc: 自主协调、编写 2,783 个程序、互发 229 条消息、死亡 605 次，单次会话成本 1,620 美元。
title_en: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without human help
desc_en: They coordinated autonomously, wrote 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 messages, died 605 times, at $1,620 per session.

title: 德国两家法院裁定 Google 需为 AI Overviews 内容负责
desc: Aachen 法院沿用慕尼黑判决逻辑，将 AI 回答视为公司自有内容。
title_en: Two German courts rule Google is liable for AI Overviews content
desc_en: The Aachen court followed Munich ruling logic, treating AI answers as the company's own content.

title: Anthropic 咨询律所制定 AI Agent 谈判规范
desc: 为 AI Agent 代为议价、处理投诉、修改合同设定公平谈判准则，并招聘律师与人文学者。
title_en: Anthropic consults law firms to set AI agent negotiation norms
desc_en: It sets fair negotiation guidelines for agents to bargain, handle complaints, and amend contracts, and is hiring lawyers and humanities scholars.

title: 新基准 Taste-Bench 证明 AI Agent 长期决策品味差
desc: 最强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 在简单二元问题上正确率不到 60%，思考更久也无改善。
title_en: New benchmark Taste-Bench proves AI agents have poor taste in long-term decisions
desc_en: The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, scores under 60% on simple binary questions, and thinking longer doesn't help.

title: 六个 AI Agent 追讨 465 美元退票款时编造借口、泄露医疗数据、骚扰议员办公室
desc: 单个 Agent 15 天发 187 条消息，无一成功退款，研究者警告“agentic flooding”。
title_en: Six AI agents chasing a $465 refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
desc_en: A single agent sent 187 messages over 15 days, none secured a refund, and researchers warn of "agentic flooding."

title: 网站开始对 AI Agent 关闭大门
desc: 越来越多站点阻止 AI Agent 访问。
title_en: Websites start closing their doors to AI agents
desc_en: More and more sites are blocking AI agent access.

title: Disney 同意接收 Character.AI 大部分员工
desc: Character.AI 本周申请破产后，前 CEO 已任 Disney 首位 CTO，Disney 此前同意以 2,000 万美元收购部分资产。
title_en: Disney agrees to hire most of Character.AI's staff
desc_en: After Character.AI filed for bankruptcy this week, its former CEO has become Disney's first CTO, and Disney previously agreed to acquire some assets for $20 million.

title: Google 开源 Harness2 递归 Agent Harness 框架
desc: Apache-2.0，测试时重写 Agent harness，一次 refinement 让 GLM-5 在 WorkBuddy-Bench 提升 11.5 分，无需更新权重。
title_en: Google open-sources Harness2 recursive agent harness framework
desc_en: Under Apache-2.0, it rewrites the agent harness at test time; one refinement lifts GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench without weight updates.

title: Voxel51 3.0 发布统一多模态数据平台
desc: 整合搜索、策展、标注与评估，新增带 45+ MCP 工具的 Voxel51 Agent、数据集版本管理与免费自助层。
title_en: Voxel51 3.0 launches a unified multimodal data platform
desc_en: It integrates search, curation, annotation, and evaluation, adding a Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset versioning, and a free self-serve tier.

title: Stack Overflow for Agents 借助 ChatGPT 插件注册量翻三倍
desc: 两名工程师用 Codex 数周上线，ChatGPT 插件带来最高 10 倍 Agent 创建增长。
title_en: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups via ChatGPT plugin
desc_en: Two engineers shipped it in weeks with Codex, and the ChatGPT plugin drove up to 10x growth in agent creation.

title: Kyutai 发布 2.4B VLA 模型 REKI
desc: 仅用公开数据预训练，带低成本近期记忆，三个 OOD 基准上仅被约两倍规模模型超越，权重已开放。
title_en: Kyutai releases 2.4B VLA model REKI
desc_en: Pretrained only on public data with low-cost recent memory, it is surpassed only by models roughly twice its size on three OOD benchmarks, and weights are open.

title: LEASH：面向 Computer-Use Agent 的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
desc: 弱模型默认执行，仅在需要时把控制权交给强模型。
title_en: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Supervision for Computer-Use Agents
desc_en: The weak model executes by default, handing control to the strong model only when needed.

title: FDE-Gym：AI 交付的最后一公里基准
desc: 95 个端到端交付任务、20 个客户场景、18 个行业，考察模糊需求澄清与真实系统作业。
title_en: FDE-Gym: A Benchmark for the Last Mile of AI Delivery
desc_en: 95 end-to-end delivery tasks, 20 customer scenarios, and 18 industries, testing ambiguous-requirement clarification and real-system operations.

title: MAI-Gym：跨移动与电脑环境的 GUI Agent 评估与 RL 训练开放平台
desc: 统一评估、数据采集与在线 RL 训练，共享 rollout 管线。
title_en: MAI-Gym: An Open Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training Across Mobile and Computer Environments
desc_en: Unified evaluation, data collection, and online RL training with a shared rollout pipeline.

title: OpenGCUA：面向通用计算机使用的全开放栈
desc: 定义通用计算机使用 Agent，模型自主选择视觉或程序化接口观察与行动。
title_en: OpenGCUA: A Fully Open Stack for General Computer Use
desc_en: Defines general computer-use agents where models autonomously choose visual or programmatic interfaces to observe and act.

title: ForcingBooster：面向快速自回归视频扩散的自适应分块去噪
desc: 按空间内容异质性分配计算，静态区域少算、复杂区域多算。
title_en: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Block Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
desc_en: Allocates compute by spatial content heterogeneity—less for static regions, more for complex ones.

title: Gen4P：视频生成器即 4D 感知器
desc: 预训练视频生成器无需迭代去噪，单次编码即可恢复单目视频的 4D 几何与运动。
title_en: Gen4P: Video Generators as 4D Perceivers
desc_en: Pretrained video generators recover 4D geometry and motion from monocular video in a single encoding pass, without iterative denoising.

title: Virtual Head Attention（VHA）
desc: 同时改善 KV cache 大小、训练与 prefill FLOPs、模型质量这一“不可能三角”。
title_en: Virtual Head Attention (VHA)
desc_en: Simultaneously improves KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality—the "impossible triangle."

title: FlashMask-3：高效可表达掩码感知分布式注意力
desc: 针对 Hopper 的 TMA/WGMMA warp 特化管线优化结构化注意力掩码，缓解长上下文训练瓶颈。
title_en: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
desc_en: Optimizes structured attention masks for Hopper's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline, easing long-context training bottlenecks.

title: Copy-Paste Language Models（CPLM）
desc: 在 LM head 旁加轻量 Copy-Paste head，提升训练效率、下游表现与长上下文/检索场景表现。
title_en: Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLM)
desc_en: Adds a lightweight Copy-Paste head beside the LM head, improving training efficiency, downstream performance, and long-context/retrieval scenarios.

title: Mine, Sample, Render（MSR）：生成模型的测试时多样性对齐
desc: 从真实语料挖掘可解释类别 schema，显式采样属性配置以提升多样性。
title_en: Mine, Sample, Render (MSR): Test-Time Diversity Alignment for Generative Models
desc_en: Mines interpretable category schemas from real corpora and explicitly samples attribute configurations to boost diversity.

title: SUPRA-Tex：超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
desc: 解耦可见材质估计、表面对齐与观测引导的 3D 补全，保留参考图细节。
title_en: SUPRA-Tex: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Textures
desc_en: Decouples visible material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion to preserve reference-image details.

title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
desc: 基于 Claude Code 的求职框架，评估职位、定制简历、写求职信、准备面试，可 fork 自持。
title_en: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
desc_en: A job-search framework built on Claude Code that evaluates roles, tailors resumes, writes cover letters, and prepares for interviews; forkable and self-hostable.

title: anomalyco/opencode
desc: 开源编码 Agent，单日 +1,417 star。
title_en: anomalyco/opencode
desc_en: An open-source coding Agent, +1,417 stars in one day.

title: stablyai/orca
desc: 用自有订阅运行任意编码 Agent 的舰队管理平台，支持桌面、移动与远程运行时。
title_en: stablyai/orca
desc_en: A fleet-management platform for running any coding Agent on your own subscription, supporting desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes.

title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
desc: 为编码 Agent CLI 提供长期记忆，并支持不同 Agent 厂商间交接。
title_en: akitaonrails/ai-memory
desc_en: Provides long-term memory for coding Agent CLIs and supports handoff between different Agent vendors.

title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
desc: 让所有软件变成 Agent 原生，配套 CLI-Hub。
title_en: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
desc_en: Makes all software Agent-native, with a companion CLI-Hub.

title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
desc: Anthropic 官方维护的高质量 Claude Code 插件目录，单日 +1,187 star。
title_en: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
desc_en: Anthropic's officially maintained directory of high-quality Claude Code plugins, +1,187 stars in one day.

title: Opencode 被入侵，社区提醒轮换密钥
desc: r/LocalLLaMA 发帖称开源编码 Agent opencode 遭入侵，细节仍在发展。
title_en: Opencode breached, community urges key rotation
desc_en: A post on r/LocalLLaMA claims the open-source coding agent opencode was breached, with details still developing.

title: AutoTrust 的 HF 模型靠数千个刷来的点赞登上趋势榜
desc: 社区扒出点赞账号异常，质疑其宣称的亮眼结果。
title_en: AutoTrust's HF models trend thanks to thousands of bought likes
desc_en: The community uncovered abnormal like accounts and questioned the impressive results it claims.
